comment: Day+Swing watchlist v7.7 — diversified beyond tech. FIELDS: 'night' = eToro 24/5 overnight-eligible (true = bot may trade it when the US regular session is closed; false = regular/extended hours only, so it never sends a reject-able order). Flags are BEST-EFFORT — verify in the eToro app and flip one if it's wrong; a wrong 'false' just means no overnight trade (safe), a wrong 'true' means an occasional harmless reject. ADRs and most non-mega-caps are set false. 'sizeMultiplier' (optional, 0-1) scales the position size for that symbol only — used to KEEP a name in the universe while trading it smaller, instead of the all-or-nothing choice of full size or deletion. Absent = 1.0 (no change). ALL symbols verified tradeable on eToro as EQUITIES on 2026-08-06. Screened to exclude gambling, alcohol, tobacco, adult, interest-based banking/insurance, and crypto-primary businesses — see src/strategies/ethics-filter.js for the enforced blocklist.
changelog_v7_7: REMOVED RIVN (ev bucket lost $18.59/trade over 14 trades; RIVN alone -$140.54). KEPT TSLA at sizeMultiplier 0.5 per request. ADDED 16 names across healthcare, energy, industrials, consumer, materials, telecom, cybersecurity and e-commerce — the watchlist previously had zero non-tech diversification apart from BA. Rationale: mega_cap was the ONLY profitable bucket (+$202.99, 68% win) at just 11% of trades, while semi (-$439.46) took 40%. CVX was evaluated and EXCLUDED — not available as an equity on eToro.
